public.footer: {{org}} uses Custock to keep you posted

home.customersFoot: These open from a QR code on the window, the shelf or a receipt.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.body: The link may be old or mistyped.

join.lead: Get news, offers and a heads up when things are back in stock. Only what you choose, and you can stop any time.
join.name: Name
join.emailInvalid: That email does not look right.
join.interestsFoot: Optional. We use this to send you less, not more.
join.channelsFoot: Both are off until you turn them on.
join.emailNewsSub: From {{org}}, a few times a month at most
join.pushSub: Offers and back in stock alerts, at most 2 a day
join.over15Needed: You need to be 15 or older to join.
join.privacy: {{org}} keeps your details and never shares them. You can see or delete your data at any time.
join.notifyIntent: We will also tell you when {{product}} is back.
join.checkBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm, then you are in.
join.checkHint: Nothing there? Look in spam, or give it a minute.

confirm.title: You are in
confirm.body: You now follow {{scope}}. News and offers will come the way you chose.
confirm.app: Sign in with your email, then add {{org}} to your Home Screen for offers in one tap.
confirm.failBody: It may have expired. Scan the QR code again to get a new one.

product.askShop: Ask in the shop about availability.
product.notifyMe: Tell me when it is back
product.wasNote: Was price is the lowest of the last 30 days.
product.readOnly: You can see this product, your role cannot change its stock.
product.stockFoot: Numbers are the sum of every movement, nothing is ever overwritten.
product.shopPriceSub: Same as the base price unless you change it
product.costHidden: Costs are hidden for your role
product.barcodesFoot: Scanning any of these finds this product.
product.historyFoot: Latest first. Undo creates a new line, it never deletes one.
product.backInStockToast_one: Back in stock. {{count}} customer was told.
product.backInStockToast_other: Back in stock. {{count}} customers were told.
product.lowStockToast: Running low in {{shop}}. The managers got a notification.
product.transferTip: Some of this is on the way from another shop. It counts once it is received.
product.archiveConfirm: Archiving hides it from lists and scans. Its history stays and you can still find it in reports.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.noResultsBody: Nothing found for "{{q}}". Try fewer words, or Greeklish.
catalog.closedBody: {{org}} does not share its catalog. Join to get their offers.
catalog.followersBody: Join to browse them. It takes a few seconds and you choose what you hear about.

offers.title: Offers
offers.emptyBody: Follow the shop to hear about the next one.

unsubscribe.title: Stop emails
unsubscribe.lead: Pick what to stop. It takes effect right away.
unsubscribe.foot: You keep any other shops you follow. You can join again from any QR code.

login.lead: Sign in to run your shops.
login.wrong: Email or password is not right.
login.devFoot: Development only. Each person has a different role, so you can see what each one can and cannot do.

admin.noOrgBody: You are not a member of any business. Ask for an invite.
admin.offlineBody: Your session is fine. Check the connection and try again.

dash.allClear: Approvals, counts and fixes show up here.
dash.tipQr: Print the window QR from QR codes. People join in 30 seconds, no app needed.

stock.title: Stock
stock.search: Search by name, Greeklish or barcode

empty.all: Add your first product, or scan one with the phone app.

stock.unknownFoot: Staff scanned these and they matched nothing. Add them to a product or create a new one.
stock.tipScan: The phone app is faster for stock: scan to receive, sell or count. This screen is for checking and fixing.

form.name: Name
form.foot: Leave the barcode empty and we make our own label code.

stock.attachTo: Which product is this code for?

stockSheet.reasonFoot: Damaged, expired and theft count as shrinkage in reports.
stockSheet.confirmBig_one: That is {{count}} unit in one go. Save it?
stockSheet.confirmBig_other: That is {{count}} units in one go. Save it?
stockSheet.confirmNegative: This makes stock negative. It will show in the negative stock list until someone fixes it.
stockSheet.undone: Undone. A reversal line was added.
stockSheet.onlyYourShops: Only the shops where your role allows this
stockSheet.noShop: Your role cannot do this in any shop.

customers.title: Customers
customers.search: Search by name, email or tag
customers.emptyBody: Print your window QR. People join in 30 seconds.
customers.noAccess: Customers are not part of your role
customers.maskedWhy: Email and phone are partly hidden for your role
customers.addLead: Hand the phone over so they type their own details. They get a confirmation email, nothing else until they confirm.
customers.addConsent: Asked and agreed at the counter
customers.added: {{name}} added. A confirmation email is on its way.

customer.channelsFoot: Only the customer can turn a channel on. You can see the proof below.
customer.waitingFoot: They get one message when it is back, then it is done.
customer.addNote: Add a note for the team
customer.consentsFoot: Every yes and every stop, with the exact wording they saw.
customer.eraseFoot: For a GDPR request. Personal details are wiped, counts in reports stay.
customer.eraseConsequence: This wipes {{name}}'s name, email, phone, tags and notes for good. Counts in reports stay. It cannot be undone.

posts.title: Posts
posts.emptyBody: Write news or an offer. Customers get it in the feed, and by push or email if they chose that.

composer.title: New post
composer.bodyPh: What do you want to tell them?
composer.defaultLangFoot: Required. Everyone gets this one unless you write their language too.
composer.otherLangFoot: Optional. Followers who read this language get it instead of the default.
composer.wasNote: The was price is worked out for you: the lowest price of the last 30 days, as EU rules ask.
composer.audienceFoot: Only shops where your role lets you post are listed.
composer.feedSub: Always on. It is where the post lives.
composer.pickAudience: Pick at least one shop to see who this reaches.
composer.pushNot: {{off}} turned push off, {{noApp}} do not have the app.
composer.quietHours: It is quiet hours now, so pushes wait until 09:00.
composer.quietHoursRule: Pushes between 22:00 and 09:00 wait until morning.
composer.emailUnconfirmed: {{n}} have not confirmed their email yet.
composer.capRule: Nobody gets more than 2 pushes a day from you. Extra ones still reach the feed.
composer.approvalRole: Your role needs an admin to approve posts for these shops.
composer.approvalOrg: This business asks for approval before posts go out.
composer.cantRecall: Pushes and emails cannot be taken back once sent.
composer.published_one: Published. On its way to {{count}} person.
composer.published_other: Published. On its way to {{count}} people.
composer.submitted: Sent for approval. The approver got a notification.

post.waitingApproval: Waiting for an admin to approve
post.skippedSub: No consent, daily limit or a bounced email
post.opensNote: Opens are a rough guide. Some mail apps open every email on their own.
post.author: Written by
post.deleteSent: Delete it? Pushes and emails already sent cannot be taken back.

team.title: Team
team.rulesFoot: You can only manage people below your rank, and only give permissions you have yourself.

blocked.ceiling: Has permissions you do not have

why.ceiling: Includes permissions you do not have

team.inviteFoot: The invite is valid for 7 days and only for this email.
team.invitedSub: They get an email in their language with a link to join.
team.suspendSub: They cannot sign in to this business. Everything they did stays.
team.removeSub: Their history stays as a former member.
team.linkReadySub: Send it to {{email}} however you like. It works once, for 7 days.

roles.title: Roles
roles.foot: Roles at or above your rank are locked for you.
roles.name: Role name
roles.affects_one: This changes access for {{count}} person right away.
roles.affects_other: This changes access for {{count}} people right away.
roles.manageFoot: People with this role can invite and manage the roles they sit above.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Last 14 days, in the shop time zone
reports.moneyHidden: Money is hidden for your role. Counts are still here.
reports.wantedSub: People waiting with notify me. A good reason to order more.
reports.links: Which QR code brings people in
reports.linksSub: Opens, then sign ups, then confirmed emails
reports.topSubMoney: Sales value, units sold beside it

settings.title: Settings
settings.customerPageLead: Your choice, for the whole business. The preview shows what a customer sees.

catalogFoot.off: Customers only get your posts and offers.
catalogFoot.subscribers: People who follow you can browse your products in the app and on the web.
catalogFoot.public: Anyone with the link can browse, including search engines.

settings.pricesFoot: Turn off for made to order or ask in the shop items.

stockFoot.availability: In stock, only a few left, or out of stock, per shop.
stockFoot.exact: The real number per shop, for example 7 in stock.

settings.competitors: Exact numbers are visible to anyone who can see the catalog, competitors too.
settings.perShopFoot: A shop can show less than the business setting, or hide itself, like a warehouse.
settings.negativeFoot: On: a sale before the delivery is recorded still goes through and shows up to fix. Off: the server refuses it.
settings.approvalFoot: Managers can write posts, an admin publishes them.
settings.pushFoot: Keeps push welcome. Extra posts still reach the feed.
settings.readOnly: Only an owner or admin can change business settings.
settings.previewFoot: A product with 7, 2 and 0 in three shops.
settings.previewOff: Catalog is off, so customers only see posts.

shopPageState.off: Customers see your posts and offers only. Turn the catalog on to let them browse.
shopPageState.subscribers: Only people who follow you can browse it. Strangers who open the link are asked to join first.
shopPageState.public: Anyone with the link can browse your catalog. Put it on your window, receipts and social media.

links.title: QR codes
links.tip: Give each poster its own label, like window or receipt, so you can see which one works.
links.emptyBody: Make one for your window and print it.
links.labelFoot: Only your team sees the label.

poster.line: Scan for news and offers from {{org}}

scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.hint: Hold the code inside the frame. A usb scanner also works, it types into the field.
scan.noCamera: No camera access. Type the code, or allow the camera in the browser settings.

productForm.barcodeFoot: Leave it empty and add one later, or make our own code for products without one.
productForm.barcodeAddFoot_one: This product has {{count}} barcode. A new one is added, the old ones keep working.
productForm.barcodeAddFoot_other: This product has {{count}} barcodes. A new one is added, the old ones keep working.
productForm.unitFoot: Kilo, litre and metre are counted to three decimals.
productForm.variantsFoot: Sizes, colours or flavours. Each variant gets its own stock and barcode.
productForm.photoFoot: Up to 10 photos, the first one is the cover. We shrink them before they upload.
productForm.priceFoot: With VAT, as on the shelf.
productForm.trackFoot: Off for services and things nobody counts.
productForm.needName: Add a name to create the product.
productForm.uploadFailed: That photo did not upload. Try another one.

shopSettings.priceFoot: Leave empty to use the base price.
shopSettings.reorderFoot: When stock drops to this, the managers get one notification.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.emptyBody: Count a shelf, a category or the whole shop. Several people can count at once.
counts.openFoot: Counts in review wait for someone who can approve them.

kindFoot.full: At the end you decide what happens to products nobody counted.
kindFoot.partial: Only what you scan is changed.

counts.scanPh: Scan or type a barcode, then Enter
counts.blindFoot: Expected numbers stay hidden while counting, so nobody counts towards them.

uncountedFoot.ignore: Their stock stays as it is.
uncountedFoot.set_zero: Their stock becomes zero. Use this only if the whole shop was counted.

counts.waitingApproval: Someone with count approval applies this.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.emptyBody: Send stock from one shop to another. It shows as on the way until it is received.
transfers.incomingFoot: Count what arrived and confirm. Anything missing is recorded as lost in transit.
transfers.draftFoot: Nothing moves until you send it.
transfers.sent: Sent. The receiving shop got a notification.
transfers.receiveFoot: Change the number if less arrived than was sent.
transfers.shortWarn: {{n}} missing will be recorded as lost in transit.
transfers.lostFoot: Lost items count as shrinkage in reports.
transfers.onlyReceiving: Only the receiving shop can confirm this.

action.stock.movement_on_archived: moved stock of an archived product
action.stock.negative_accepted_offline: synced an offline sale below zero

s.priceChanged: {{actor}} changed the price of {{name}} from {{from}} to {{to}}

outbox.title: Dev outbox
outbox.lead: Emails and pushes that would have gone out. Development only, nothing leaves this machine.
outbox.tip: Publish a post or receive a product people wait for, then come back here to see each message per customer, in their language.
outbox.emptyBody: Messages show up here as soon as something fans out.
outbox.offBody: The outbox only exists when the api runs in development mode.
outbox.showPushesSub: Each new push in the outbox appears as a real notification here. Nothing leaves the server.

today.title: Today
today.mineFoot: Undo works for an hour. After that, ask a manager.

hint.lookup: Point at a barcode to open the product.
hint.receive: Scan everything that arrived, then confirm once.
hint.sell: Each scan takes one off, with undo.
hint.count: Scan each item. Differences show against the expected stock.
hint.transfer: Scan what goes to the other shop, then pick the shop.

scanner.countNeedsApproval: Counts are applied by a manager. Show them this list.
scanner.damaged: This code looks damaged. Check the digits.
scanner.unknownSaved: Saved for your manager, who can add it to a product.
scanner.cameraWhy: The camera reads barcodes. Nothing is recorded or saved.
scanner.noModesTitle: Nothing to scan for your role
scanner.noModesBody: Your role can look at stock but not change it.
scanner.lowStock_one: {{count}} product just dropped to its reorder point
scanner.lowStock_other: {{count}} products just dropped to their reorder point
scanner.countSubmitted: Count sent to your manager for review
scanner.pickShop: Pick the shop it goes to
scanner.noDestination: There is no other shop to send to.
scanner.title: Scan
scanner.denied: The camera is off for this site. Allow it in the browser settings (Safari: aA, Website Settings; Chrome: the icon left of the address), then try again.
scanner.unavailable: No camera here. Type the code, or use a usb scanner, it types into the field.

offline.title: Waiting to sync
offline.onlineBody: Saved movements go out on their own. You can also send them now.
offline.offlineBody: No connection. Sales, deliveries and corrections are saved on this device and go out when the connection is back.
offline.refusedFooter: The server did not accept these, for the reason shown. Show them to your manager, then remove them here.
offline.savedSale: No signal. Sale of {{count}} × {{name}} saved, it syncs later
offline.savedReceive_one: No signal. {{count}} item saved, it syncs later
offline.savedReceive_other: No signal. {{count}} items saved, they sync later
offline.savedAdjust: No signal. Saved, it syncs later
offline.line: No connection. Stock changes are saved on this device and sync later.
offline.needsSignal: This needs a connection. Try again when you are back online.
offline.modeNeedsSignal: Counts and transfers need a connection. Look up, sell and receive work without one.
offline.signOutWarning_one: {{count}} change is not synced yet. Signing out deletes it from this device.
offline.signOutWarning_other: {{count}} changes are not synced yet. Signing out deletes them from this device.

pwa.staffDescription: Stock, scanning, customers and posts for your shops.
pwa.orgDescription: Offers, news and back in stock alerts from {{org}}.
pwa.offlineBody: This page needs the internet. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.
pwa.staffCoachBody: Opens full screen in one tap, scans with the camera, keeps working with weak signal and can alert you.
pwa.orgCoachBody: Offers and news in one tap, and a note on your phone when something you wait for is back.
pwa.stepsLead: Two taps in Safari and {{app}} is on your Home Screen like an app.
pwa.step1: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar.
pwa.step2: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
pwa.step3: Tap Add. Open {{app}} from your Home Screen.
pwa.stepsFoot: On iPad the Share button is at the top. In Chrome on iPhone it is in the address bar.

push.staffSub: Low stock, deliveries on the way, posts to approve.
push.staffFoot: Only on this device, and only what your role can see.

why.install: On iPhone, notifications work once this is on your Home Screen.
why.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser or phone settings.
why.off: Notifications are not set up on this server yet.
why.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

push.nudgeBody: Turn on notifications and {{org}} can tell you the moment it is back.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: No password. We email you a 6 digit code. Use the email you joined {{org}} with.
signIn.sentTo: We sent a code to {{email}}. It works for 10 minutes.
signIn.devCode: Development: the code is {{code}}. Nothing was emailed.
signIn.wrongCode: That code is not right, or it expired.

news.title: News
news.hello: Hi {{name}}, here is what is new.
news.emptyBody: When {{org}} posts news or an offer, it lands here.
news.signInLead: News and offers from {{org}}, for the people who follow it. No password, a code by email.
news.notFollowingBody: Join to get their news and offers. You choose how you hear from them.

me.title: You
me.pushSub: Offers, news and back in stock, at most 2 a day
me.channelsFoot: Never between 22:00 and 09:00. You can change this anytime.
me.waitingFoot: You hear once, when it is back.
me.privacyFoot: Each business only sees what you shared with it.
me.deleteBody: Your details are erased from every business you follow and you are signed out. This cannot be undone.

product.notifySet: Done. We will tell you once, when it is back.

landing.lead: Stock and customers for your shops, in one app on your phone.
landing.scanTitle: Scan to sell, receive and count
landing.scanSub: The phone camera is the barcode reader. Works with weak signal.
landing.peopleSub: They join from a QR code at the till, the window or a receipt.
landing.offersSub: Posts by push and email, and a note when what they wait for is back.
landing.inviteOnly: New here? Your team sends you an invite link.

invite.title: Join {{org}}
invite.name: Your name
invite.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few words are easier to remember.
invite.signInLead: You already have an account with this email. Sign in to accept.
invite.accountExists: This email already has an account. Sign in to accept.
invite.goneBody: It was used, revoked or is older than 7 days. Ask for a new one.
